verses.1: Iakobos, servant of God and Lord Jesus Christ, rejoices in these twelve tribes during the dispersion.
verses.2: My brothers, you were filled with joy when you went through various trials.
verses.3: Knowing that your faith is being tested with great patience.
verses.4: But patience is necessary for completing a task successfully, so that it becomes perfect and complete, without any flaws.
verses.5: If anyone of you lacks wisdom, then ask the one who gives God’s teachings openly and without hypocrisy. He will give it to him.
verses.6: And he should claim his rights in good faith, without any discrimination. For those who discriminate would seem like waves of wind and currents that are constantly moving around.
verses.7: For no man should think that he has done anything good in relation to his lord.
verses.8: A man with two penises, who is incomplete in all aspects of his being.
verses.9: I also am ashamed of my humble brother in his height.
verses.10: But the rich man, in his humility, was like a flower that was blown away by the wind.
verses.11: For the sun, along with its heat, destroyed everything; the flower fell from its stem, and the beauty of his face was lost. In the same way, the rich man will also be destroyed in his own wealth.
verses.12: He is a man who can endure hardships; he deserves to be honored with the crown of life, as he has been commanded by those who love him.
verses.13: No one should try to say that I’m being tested by God. For God is indeed a tester of evil; he tests none else.
verses.14: Each person, however, is subjected to his own desires, being pulled away and driven along by those desires.
verses.15: Then, that desire to possess became a sin. And once that sin was committed, it led to death.
verses.16: Do not be misled, my beloved brothers.
verses.17: Every act of kindness and every gift is truly excellent. It goes beyond the limits of what one can do from one’s own strength; it goes beyond any limitations or restrictions.
verses.18: He decided to lead us by the truth of his words, so that we would have a beginning in his creations.
verses.19: Be, my beloved brothers. Be people who are quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to get angry.
verses.20: For anger does not work for a man’s justice of God.
verses.21: Therefore, by putting aside all kinds of selfishness and evil desires, you should embrace the natural truth that can save your souls.
verses.22: Be also poets of speech, and do not merely listen and contradict others.
verses.23: Since someone who listens to words is not necessarily a poet either, it seems that this person understands the nature of his own destiny in its most basic form.
verses.24: For he had deceived himself, and he became free from his own lies. And immediately, everyone knew who he really was.
verses.25: And he who rises to the level of perfect law and freedom, and remains in that state, will not be subject to imprisonment. Instead, he will become a creator of works of art. He will be happy in his creations.
verses.26: If someone thinks that their religion is truly sacred, but they don’t use their tongue in a proper manner, and instead deceive others with their hearts, then such religion is worthless.
verses.27: It is a religion that is pure and untainted by anything related to God or their father. It involves caring for the poor and suffering people, and staying true to oneself amidst all the hardships of life.
